material: felt mallet on a small wooden block, dry, no reverb, no tail, clean transient

tick.prompt: single very short tick, one-shot UI feedback, bright

tap.prompt: soft muted tap, short body, one-shot

send.prompt: two very quick rising notes, damped, muted, very short decay, stops immediately, confirmation

receive.prompt: two soft quick descending notes, damped, muted, very short decay, stops immediately, incoming message

error.prompt: short low dull thud with a slight downward pitch, rubber on wood

success.prompt: three ascending mellow notes, major, warm, short decay, completion
